question: Which collective celestial and universal groups must receive offerings in this sequence?
premises: The groups of constellations and zodiac signs are recipients
The host of all beings is also a recipient
Offerings are given to them likewise
inference: Offerings should likewise be given to the groups of constellations and zodiac signs and to the host of all.
plain_english: Likewise to the groups of constellations and zodiac signs, and to the host of all beings.
